subject_name: Numerical Linear Algebra and Optimization Techniques
description: Covers advanced numerical matrix decompositions, direct and iterative solvers, convex optimization theory, and constrained mathematical programming for data science.
learning_objectives: Perform numerical matrix factorizations including LU, Cholesky, QR, SVD, and Spectral Decompositions.
Solve large linear systems using direct and iterative Krylov subspace methods.
Formulate convex optimization problems and understand duality and KKT optimality conditions.
Implement gradient-based, second-order, and constrained optimization algorithms.
outline: Matrix Decompositions: Vector/matrix norms, conditioning, orthogonality, QR decomposition, SVD, PCA, Spectral theorem, Jordan canonical form.
Numerical Solvers: Gaussian elimination, LU, Cholesky factorization, Jacobi, Gauss-Seidel, Conjugate Gradient, GMRES.
Eigenvalue Computation: Power method, inverse iteration, QR algorithm for eigenvalue computation.
Convex Analysis: Convex sets, convex functions, epigraphs, subgradients, Jensen's inequality.
Unconstrained Optimization: Gradient descent, line search, Newton's method, Quasi-Newton methods (BFGS, L-BFGS).
Constrained Optimization: Lagrange multipliers, KKT conditions, Duality theory (Primal-Dual formulations), ADMM, Interior point methods.
Lab Component: Implementation of matrix algorithms and convex optimization solvers in Python/CVXPY.
